4b4ce400.text:
If anyone finds this, please, do your best to stop them. There were only a few left at the tower when I scribbled this note and crawled away.

Also, try and get Raani's lucky feather from his body. He liked to tell tall tales about how he plucked it from some kind of firebird and I think he'd want to make sure that it made its way back home.

If you are also able to retrieve Arvensus Shadowsong's family signet from his body, please do so. High Elder Shadowsong is his uncle and he would want it to be returned to the family.
4b4ce400.title: Bloody Note

4f53a1ae.text:
As soon as the fighting stopped, they started moving massive crates of windstones to the top of the tower. The leader, some kind of priest, said something about a ritual.

I'm writing this note just in case I don't make it back to Shen'dar to warn Aonda, but they are doing something here. Something bad.
4f53a1ae.title: Bloody Note

909666a3.text: The cult hit us by surprise. Raani never saw it coming and Arvensus took a sword to the gut. For my part, I took a lightning bolt to the chest and blacked out. They never bothered to finish me off... I guess they assumed my wounds would do me in. When it's all said and done, I suspect they might.
909666a3.title: Bloody Note

10088|0e051c59.name: Xao'tsu
10088|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10181|6887b693.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
10181|6887b693.text:
I've heard of you. Windshapers. Wayward children of ancient Eldre'Thalas.

I once would have called you kin--albeit distant kin. Now I have no more in common with elfkind than I have with any of the other living races. All I value from any creature that draws breath is how well they may further the goals of the Forsaken. Make yourself useful to my people, and you will be welcome in our lands.

Go. Explore the Undercity as you like and enjoy its comforts, such as they are. Just remember, nothing escapes my notice within my own domain.

10540|5004ab66.name: Vol'jin
10540|5004ab66.text:
Ah yes, I heard of the Windshapers. It be good to be meetin' you now.

You know, my people been fighting elves for thousands of years. If you be half as fierce as your cousins from Darnassus or Quel'Thalas, the Darkspear would be glad to call you friend.

I be wishin' you well in your travels, $c. We Darkspear know all too well what it's like to have no home, so I hope you be finding what your people need to save yours.

10540|7c6995ef.name: Vol'jin
10540|7c6995ef.text: I am Vol'jin, of the Darkspear. Do you be friend, or enemy?

10879|dc8290dc.name: Harbinger Balthazad
10879|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

1387|c5ceacbe.name: Thysta
1387|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

250929|4b2429f8.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
250929|4b2429f8.text: <As you approach the enormous cyclone construct, you hear a faint buzzing emanating from beneath its massive armor plates. If you listen carefully, you think you might be able to hear a few words being formed but they are too distorted to make out.>

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251684|3fc9c33a.name: Strange Hermit
251684|3fc9c33a.text:
Oh, these things? I built them. My little friends helped me. I'm not very good at remembering things, but, um, I do know that at one point I used to build a lot of things. Big things! But then, like I said... I was here. The things I build aren't so big and impressive anymore. Still makes me h-happy, heh.

B-but... If you want, I can show you how to build things too!

251684|5d8faa22.name: Strange Hermit
251684|5d8faa22.text: H-Hello. You'll have to excuse me, I'm used to your kind running from me.

251684|f390af9b.name: Strange Hermit
251684|f390af9b.text:
That is... a very good question. I have a hard time remembering things, but I do remember something... "Engineer", perhaps? I think that's what, or who, I was.

Other than that, all I can seem to remember is soaring through the sky, then seeing a flash of lightning before things got very bumpy. Then... a crash.

It's been... a long time though. A very long time.

251684|ff48bdd6.name: Strange Hermit
251684|ff48bdd6.text: Oh, that's okay. I-I'll be here if you want to learn some other time. T-Thank you for talking to me!

251902|f56638d6.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|f56638d6.text:
Greetings, child. I am Illaya Amberwind and I am the Elder Windshaper here on Zephras Isle. It's always nice to meet young new faces that make their way down from the grove.

Don't let this old shaman hold you up, no doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Do feel free to stop by later if you'd like.

251904|202faeeb.name: Sania Silverstream
251904|202faeeb.text: Greetings, $c. Do you come seeking the blessings of the Windlord?

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251913|70e7404c.name: Aedi Thriceforged
251913|70e7404c.text: I can teach you to swing a blacksmith's hammer, if you are willing to learn.

251968|88447c8b.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|88447c8b.text: Greetings, I am Ayessa Dawnsinger, the current Grand Skyseer of the Windshapers. What may I do for you?

251968|97b43995.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|97b43995.text:
If the High Order gave any mind at all to actually solving the problems we face and spent less time obsessing over the old magic, we'd be in a far better position as a people. It was highborne magic that brought about the ruin of the kaldorei to begin with. Those self-absorbed fools seek to repeat those mistakes!

The fact that they attempted to make peace with the cult is bad enough, but spilling Windshaper blood is what is truly unforgivable. Were it not for the imminent threat of the cult, I'd gather up our forces and go put an end to Elaadrin and the High Order once and for all.

251968|ca320a53.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|ca320a53.text: Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

252155|82bfc17b.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
252155|82bfc17b.text: <The corpse lying before you is covered in scorches and burn marks. He seems to be clutching something in his hand.>

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252376|9f7cb8ed.name: Emerii Tallgust
252376|9f7cb8ed.text: Do you seek training as a leatherworker?

252380|d62b45b0.name: Othesia Evengale
252380|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

252383|e7690d8a.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|e7690d8a.text:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?

252389|2becf397.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
252389|2becf397.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a $c, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

252392|720694b4.name: Orsaan Dalewind
252392|720694b4.text:
Greetings, young $c. Welcome to the hall of the Tradesman's Guild. Resources are tight on Zephras right now, but you should be able to find a variety of materials and wares here to keep you in top adventuring form.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

252448|14de7cf6.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|14de7cf6.text: It's always great to see you, $N.

252448|aadf0ebc.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|aadf0ebc.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

252475|3e3dd1cf.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|3e3dd1cf.text:
<Elaadrin eyes you with barely-contained hatred.> 

You would dare step foot into our sanctum after spilling High Order blood? You are very brave, or very stupid. The High Order does not forgive, nor do we forget.

Someday, you will pay for your crimes in blood.

252475|b7dd6ea5.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|b7dd6ea5.text:
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The High Order will assist the Peacekeepers. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Elaadrin lowers his voice dangerously.>

Do not mistake our willing cooperation for any sort of clemency. You owe the High Order blood, and we always collect on our debts.

252476|fcd03afb.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
252476|fcd03afb.text: It is vital that we learn more about what the cult is planning, and with the turncoat dead, the information may have died with him...

252800|d3392a1d.name: Aamelia Windfield
252800|d3392a1d.text: The Windfield Orchard has seen better days...

253372|4b6a69db.name: Dead Cultist
253372|4b6a69db.text: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>

253474|37e215b2.name: Peacekeeper
253474|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

253474|4d63cc9b.name: Peacekeeper
253474|4d63cc9b.text: You'll want to head over to the Hall of Arms on the north side of Valanaar.

253474|80396915.name: Peacekeeper
253474|80396915.text: That trainer can be found in a house near the High Order dock, on the southeastern edge of town.

253474|8b1fd97e.name: Peacekeeper
253474|8b1fd97e.text: What are you looking for, citizen?

253576|febbe4e4.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
253576|febbe4e4.text:
Most of the cultists at the Sanctum of Storms seem to have come out to respond to our attack. I never would have expected this to go so well. This was almost too easy...

I think that the Windshapers and High Order have made their push. Valennia should be with them. You should head inside and find her. We'll stay here and keep watch while Valennia and the others finish what they came here to do.

253590|2061ff16.name: Valennia Stormfist
253590|2061ff16.text: <Valennia is severely wounded and is barely holding on to consciousness.>

253849|6ace422f.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
253849|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

254084|2becf397.name: Elayaa Easewind
254084|2becf397.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a $c, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

254100|609c70df.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|609c70df.text: The Windshapers and the High Order are up to something. There are rumors floating around that both groups plan to get the skycutters running again and use them to leave the Skywall. LEAVE SKYWALL? How ridiculous. Where would they even go?

254128|8cbd94ac.name: Wardrobe
254128|8cbd94ac.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

254149|50d3b408.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|50d3b408.text:
Shadowgale Forest!

It's haunted! Haunted as the sky is blue! Terrible forest spirits, terror birds with talons as big as yer arm! It's... a nightmare!

<Swimmers turns to Donaal and belches loudly.>

 IT'S NOT CRAZY TALK, DONAAL!

254149|f642f017.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|f642f017.text:
<The $r before you sways unsteadily, clearly very inebriated.>

I used to be a sailor, you know? Before the trouble started. The skycutters used to run between the islands. Now it's unsafe or some such, or so they say.

I see the High Order and the Windshapers have their skycutters running again, but I'm stuck here, grounded!

What aren't we being told!

<He turns and yells loudly at the innkeeper.>

WHAT AREN'T WE BEING TOLD, DONAAL!?

254151|197a65c0.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|197a65c0.text: The Nightclaw do not take kindly to reckless intruders. Tread carefully while in Shadowgale, $c.

254151|20a1483e.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|20a1483e.text:
You've earned a degree of trust amongst the Nightclaw, $c. We don't have much to offer you as a reward, but we have managed to scavenge a number of crafting plans from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

The magesmiths of Ban'aethal were widely regarded to be the best artisans in all of the $R Isles. The Nightclaw are naturalists, not crafters, so these records are of little use to us.

Continue to prove yourself to be a valuable ally, and I would make these secrets available to you.

254411|0e051c59.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256076|f046599c.name: Damaged Construct
256076|f046599c.text: <A faint whirring sound can be heard coming from underneath the construct's metal armor plates. The wind powering this machine is present but is listless and only faintly churning. You don't need to know much about air constructs to know that this unit is clearly not in good repair.>

256083|35f76b60.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|35f76b60.text: Have you found what we need yet?

256083|6571d699.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|6571d699.text: <Riaani seems to be intently focused on his work on the wind construct.>

256247|c69f0372.name: Belathaan Brightwish
256247|c69f0372.text: What are you doing here? Quickly, leave this place now. You are going to ruin everything!

256635|824cc722.name: Peacekeeper
256635|824cc722.text: Adventurer! The wind bridge leading to the other spire is unstable. You may need to wait here with me until it returns.

257003|ec1a6e0b.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257006|53a09e6f.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|53a09e6f.text: Y garde bor hir uden algos me nuff nostyec lon aldonoth, far Y nagan Y borne eynes nud danagarde lo rothas melka.

257007|ac3243de.name: Melasa Fairmend
257007|ac3243de.text: Se, o ealdor Gothalgos. Y borne va vohl ru eynes nud aldonoth vrum borne gol odes methrine.

257018|ac3243de.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|ac3243de.text: Se, o ealdor Gothalgos. Y borne va vohl ru eynes nud aldonoth vrum borne gol odes methrine.

257018|d62b45b0.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257065|819f44a1.name: Missionary Jasaan
257065|819f44a1.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?

257944|37940c1f.name: Elegael Thornpaw
257944|37940c1f.text: I cannot believe we were taken by surprise by the Al'Aketh. They have never been hostile to us before, but with their ambush they injured many of my kin. I swear I will get revenge for the fallen and wounded druids of my den. Mark my words, they will pay.

258130|5a52f936.name: Jorel Windsinger
258130|5a52f936.text:
<Before you lies the corpse of Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succumbing to his wounds.>

259012|517aef13.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
259012|517aef13.text: All of the $r islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

259013|6750d3f2.name: Resaan Nimbuswalker
259013|6750d3f2.text:
<Before you lies a $r; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half-filled crate nearby lies spilled on the ground.>

262492|ca9aee41.name: Rimblat Earthshatter
262492|ca9aee41.text:
I've been expec...

<Rimblat coughs.>

Excuse me, old habit. I am Rimblat of the Earthen Ring.

262502|a7fc18c4.name: Brix Xizzix
262502|a7fc18c4.text:
Another fresh face! Welcome to Azeroth, pal. Come back and see me if you need help setting yourself up for success.

Bring money.

263570|8ac1454b.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|8ac1454b.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders. As you improve your standing with the Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a variety of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

265756|eefee559.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|eefee559.text:
Welcome to Fairweather Stables! I would love to provide you with one of our fine galestriders, but it seems like you may not yet have enough experience to ride one.

They are temperamental at times and are prone to toss newer riders if not handled correctly. I would be more than happy to provide the training for you once you are a more seasoned adventurer and have enough coin!

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

271465|92b9fbbb.name: Falfaan Halfwind
271465|92b9fbbb.text:
Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2858|d37b59d0.name: Gringer
2858|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3039|08830bac.name: Holt Thunderhorn
3039|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3039|43dfca45.name: Holt Thunderhorn
3039|43dfca45.text: Remember, all things are connected. If the beasts were gone from the land, our kind would die from a great loneliness of spirit, for whatever happens to the beasts also happens to the Tauren. Whatever befalls Azeroth befalls all those that inhabit it.

3057|114886ab.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|114886ab.text:
Muln Earthfury has told me much of the Windshapers and I am proud to open the lands--and skies--of Mulgore to your people.

The tauren and the $R are both children of this land. Kalimdor. 

I hope that your people are able to find what they are looking for here and that you are able to save your homeland. In the meantime, it is my hope that you are able to learn more of the land that your ancestors used to call home.

Please make yourself at home here in Thunder Bluff, and may the Earth Mother bless your journey.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3171|9d35dc4d.name: Thotar
3171|9d35dc4d.text: I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.

3230|3b64a31f.name: Nazgrel
3230|3b64a31f.text:
<Nazgrel grunts as he sizes you up.>

High elves, here in Orgrimmar. I'd never bet on such a thing happening in my lifetime, but at this point nothing is surprising to me.

Yes, the Warchief instructed me to draft up instructions for you. Take this letter and follow the instructions within. Conduct yourself with honor and show due deference when you meet with our leaders, elf.

Once you've finished your journey, return to the Warchief.

3230|8d5031bd.name: Nazgrel
3230|8d5031bd.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3362|ae8e419b.name: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
3362|ae8e419b.text: I only make my mounts available to those who are considered exalted to Orgrimmar and the Orcish race.  Go prove yourself to us, and I'll make my mighty wolves available for your inspection.

3406|08830bac.name: Xor'juul
3406|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3406|08e320c2.name: Xor'juul
3406|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3620|0e051c59.name: Harruk
3620|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

4488|642d4f58.name: Parqual Fintallas
4488|642d4f58.text: It's always nice when someone wishes to speak to me. How are things with you, $c?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4752|f60c8a5b.name: Kildar
4752|f60c8a5b.text: You need to be exalted with the orcs of Orgrimmar before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5814|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Thulbek
5814|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

9559|c670fd35.name: Grizzlowe
9559|c670fd35.text: I must say, Booty Bay has the best Clam Chowder to be had anywhere in the South Seas. Oh, not interested in cuisine eh? Well then let me be the first to welcome you to the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, the finest passenger ship to travel between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She's due back for another trip to Ratchet in the Barrens soon, so make yourself comfortable till she arrives.

92693-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-progress.text: There's not enough stormapples in skywall to repay you for this.
92693-progress.title: Standing Our Ground

94013-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-accept.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the $c.
94013-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94013-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-complete.text:
Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $c that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
94013-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94013-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94013-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94050-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94050-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.
94050-accept.title: Training the Beast

94050-complete.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
94050-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94050-complete.title: Training the Beast

94978-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-accept.text:
Every $c begins by learning the bond between beast and master. This is your first challenge. In time, you'll tame creatures from every corner of the world, but for now, start with our rivers and lakes on Zephras. 

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Windsong Crawler.

Show that you can earn its trust, and begin your path toward true mastery.
94978-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94978-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94978-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94978-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94979-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-accept.text:
You've proven you can tame the river's crawler. Now it's time to test your skill on open ground. The plains of Zephras echo with the cries of the galestrider, a proud, winged $c that runs like the wind.

Take this Taming Rod and seek one out. Travel to the lowlands and earn its trust.

Show you're ready for the trials yet to come.
94979-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94979-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94979-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94979-progress.title: Taming the Beast
